title: Fabric Amper mod.yaml (schema 1 and 1.1)
description: Omitting schema selects the latest loader-namespaced schema 1.1, supporting Fabric and NeoForge targets. Explicit integer schema: 1 retains legacy Fabric-only fields. A quoted string schema: "1.1" also selects schema 1.1; unquoted 1.1 is invalid. Only settings.gradle.kts and mod.yaml/mod.yml are required. The plugin validates runtime semantics.

schema.description: Omission defaults to schema 1.1. Explicit integer 1 uses legacy Fabric v1; quoted "1.1" explicitly selects loader-namespaced syntax. Unquoted numeric 1.1 is invalid.

product.description: Schema 1 uses a Fabric string. Schema 1.1 permits one loader/kind or an array with at most one target per loader. Arrays may mix mod and api kinds.

dependencies.description: Main or split-client dependencies. Schema 1.1 object entries can select loader: fabric or neoforge for one backend; omitting loader shares an entry across selected backends. Schema 1 forbids loader. exported controls API visibility; include additionally embeds a non-transitive Fabric JAR-in-JAR.

test-dependencies.description: Test-only dependencies; target: client, exported and include are not supported.

allOf.description: Architectury convenience was verified for Fabric Minecraft 26.3 only.
The non-remapping Minecraft 26.1+ profile requires Mojang official mappings and Java release 25, including when settings or mappings are omitted and defaulted by the plugin.
In schema 1.1, client-targeted Gradle dependencies need a Fabric-only split client source set.
An omitted schema or quoted 1.1 uses loader-namespaced fields; only explicit integer 1 selects legacy Fabric fields.

mavenRange.description: NeoForge Maven interval such as [1.0,), [1.0,2.0), or [1.0]. Fabric Loader >= predicates are not Maven ranges.

resourcePath.description: Relative resource path inside src/main/resources or eligible split client resources. No drive prefix, backslash, empty segment, initial dot or parent traversal; actual file existence and symlink containment are checked by Fabric Amper.

changelogPath.description: Project-relative changelogFile. Disallows absolute paths, empty/dot/parent segments, Windows separators and drive prefixes. Existence and symlink containment need filesystem validation.

versionToken.description: Quote versions in YAML when they might otherwise be interpreted as numbers.

fixedGradleVersion.description: Fixed Fabric Loader/Fabric API version; no latest.release, x wildcard, dynamic + selector or empty dot segments.

singleLineName.description: Nonempty single-line name without leading/trailing whitespace or ISO control characters.

id.description: Fabric Loader mod ID; also the default Maven artifact ID.

group.description: Maven groupId. Mandatory for fabric/api or fabric/library.

archivesName.description: Output archive base name and Maven artifactId; defaults to mod.id.

license.description: Fabric Loader license name or list of license names.

icon.description: PNG resource path under src/main/resources or the split client resources, or a pixel-size/path map.

provides.description: Unique additional Fabric mod IDs. The runtime validator also rejects an alias equal to mod.id.

entrypoints.description: Each entrypoint list accepts a class string or {adapter, value}.

languageAdapters.description: Author-defined adapters; 'kotlin' is reserved for Fabric Language Kotlin and must not be redefined.

accessWidener.description: Minecraft 26.1+ requires a .classtweaker with classTweaker v1 official header; legacy remap uses .accesswidener.

custom.description: Extensible Fabric Loader custom JSON metadata; arbitrary JSON-compatible values are allowed.

versionMap.description: Fabric Loader version predicates; a string means one requirement and an array means OR.

version.description: Exact Minecraft version; must be quoted as a YAML string.

mappings.description: Minecraft 26.1+ must use mojang; legacy remap may use yarn with a fixed version.

architectury.description: Opt-in Architectury API for Fabric Minecraft 26.3. No separate Gradle script, version property, repository or dependency declaration is needed. Does not enable Architectury Loom or create a multiplatform build.

enable.description: Enable automatic Architectury Fabric API dependency, repository, and Loader requirement.

version.description: Optional exact Architectury API version for Minecraft 26.3. When absent and enabled, the fixed audited default is 22.0.5 (verified 2026-11-16), not a dynamic Maven latest lookup.

maven.description: Custom HTTPS Maven dependency repository. Inline URL credentials and fragments are forbidden; publishing destinations use publish.maven instead.

coordinate.description: Fixed group:artifact:version Maven coordinate. Dynamic versions and ranges are rejected by Fabric Amper.

dependency.description: A Maven/Modrinth dependency object or a fixed-coordinate shorthand. The direct properties enable IDE completion inside YAML array entries before the object form is complete.

kind.description: Gradle dependency type. Modrinth defaults to mod, ordinary Maven to library.

loader.description: Schema 1.1 root dependencies object only: select one configured backend; omitted means all selected backends. Not supported in explicit schema 1, test-dependencies, or loader-specific gradleDependencies.

kind.description: Gradle dependency type. Modrinth defaults to mod, ordinary Maven to library.

platformDependency.description: Loader-specific Gradle dependency entries have an implicit backend; loader must only occur on schema 1.1 root dependencies objects.

envName.description: Environment variable NAME, not a literal username, token or password.

platformChangelog.description: A changelog may be written inline or in one project-local file, but never both.

publish.description: Opt-in remote destinations. common inherits into explicit Modrinth/CurseForge targets, but never creates a destination. Never uploads during Gradle configuration, help or build.

slug.description: CurseForge relation slug; fallback Modrinth project ID or slug.

modrinthId.description: Optional explicit Modrinth project ID when different from slug.

curseforgeId.description: Optional positive numeric STRING for CurseForge relation project ID.

publishCommon.description: Shared Modrinth/CurseForge values only; platform-specific values override. Shared gameVersions becomes Modrinth gameVersions and CurseForge gameVersionNames; CurseForge numeric gameVersions remain independent. Platform dependency/relations arrays append new identifiers and override matching inherited identifiers; [] clears inherited items. Inline changelog and changelogFile are mutually exclusive. Common never creates upload targets.

name.description: Default Modrinth versionName and CurseForge displayName.

dependencies.description: Repeated identical relationships are invalid. The Kotlin validator also rejects reused slugs/effective Modrinth IDs even when other fields differ.

publishMaven.description: Remote Maven repository. Plugin publishes final Fabric mod JAR + optional sources + POM/.module.

credentialsFromEnv.description: Exactly two environment variable names: Maven username followed by Maven password/token.

publishHttpsUrl.description: HTTPS only; user info, query parameters and fragments are forbidden.

projectId.description: Explicit Modrinth project ID/slug, not Loader mod ID or Maven GAV.

publishModrinth.description: Explicit Modrinth v2 /version release. Existing project ID and author token are required. No automatic API testing.

environment.description: Overrides the conservative environment inferred from mod.environment.

changelog.description: Nonblank multiline release notes are permitted.

changelogFile.description: Path relative to project root; outside-root paths or symlinks escaping the root are forbidden.

dependencies.description: Identical entries are invalid; reused projectId with different fields is also rejected by the Kotlin validator.

projectId.description: Exact numeric CurseForge relation project ID, serialized as a string by its author-upload API.

publishCurseForge.description: CurseForge AUTHOR upload API, not the public x-api-key catalog API. No automatic API testing.

gameVersionNames.description: Defaults to Minecraft version, Fabric loader, and relevant Client/Server tags.

gameVersions.description: Optional verified CurseForge upload-game-version IDs, NOT Minecraft version strings or Core API enum numbers.

changelog.description: Nonblank multiline release notes are permitted.

relations.description: Identical entries are invalid; repeated slugs with different fields are also rejected by the Kotlin validator.

publishing.description: Optional for fabric/api or fabric/library only. A safe local Maven repository is always configured.

repository.description: Remote upload destination, only invoked by an explicit publishing task. No literal credentials in YAML.

url.description: HTTPS Maven URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment.

usernameEnv.description: Name of an environment variable holding the username, not the username itself.

passwordEnv.description: Name of an environment variable holding the password/token, not the secret itself.

common.name: Shared Release 1.0.0
common.changelog: Local metadata example; do not upload.
